一根线，每一拍送一位。从传一位话开始，一层层搭出能可靠地收发一帧的网卡。: One wire, one bit a tick. Start by passing a bit on, and build up, layer by layer, a network card that sends and receives a frame reliably.
线上每一拍送一位：怎样说，怎样听？: A bit on the wire each tick: how to speak, how to hear?
世界前进的一步：每一拍，每根线送一位，板上的电路算一遍。: One step of the world: each tick every wire carries one bit and the board computes once.
一根线每一拍送一位：0 或 1。: A wire carries one bit a tick: 0 or 1.
每一拍把左线上到达的位说到右线上。: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit arriving on the left-hand wire.
板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下。要留下一个值到下一拍，用一对新元件: The board computes afresh every tick and keeps nothing once done. To keep a value for the next tick there is a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.
寄存卡让电路记得上一拍。: A register lets a circuit remember the tick before.
每一拍在右线上说出左线上一拍的位；第一拍说 0。: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit the left-hand wire had the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.
给出同名寄存卡中存的值；尚未存入时，给出初值（「—」或设定的数）。: Gives the value held in the register of the same name; before anything is stored, gives its start value (「—」 or the number set).
把接入的值存进同名寄存卡，从下一拍起可以读出；接入的是「—」时也存进去，不接时不: Stores its input in the register of the same name; it can be read from the next tick on. A 「—」 is stored like any value; with nothing wired, nothing is stored and the register keeps what it had.
始终给出设定的数。: Always gives the number it is set to.
「条件」为「是」或 1 时给出「是」输入，为「否」或 0 时给出「否」输入，为「: Gives its Yes input when Condition is yes or 1, its No input when Condition is no or 0, and 「—」 when Condition is 「—」; an unconnected input reads 「—」.
给出两个数之和。只要有一个输入为「—」，就给出「—」。: Gives the sum of its two numbers. Gives 「—」 if either input is 「—」.
两个数相同时给出「是」，否则给出「否」（「是」算作 1，「否」算作 0）。只要有: Gives yes when its two numbers are the same, no otherwise (yes counts as 1, no as 0). Gives 「—」 if either input is 「—」.
给出 8 位数「数」从最高位数起的第「位」位（第 0 位是最高位）；「位」不在: Gives bit “Index” of the 8-bit number “Number”, counting from the top (bit 0 is the highest); gives 「—」 when the index is not 0 to 7 or either input is 「—」.
